worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages (person 0) 10,000.00 + railroad retirement (person 0) 30,000.00 = 40,000.00. Federal taxable income = 40,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 24,250.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Filing status single, no Montana standard deduction or exemptions. Schedule I Part I: line 7 additions 0.00; lines 22 and 23 railroad retirement 30,000.00; line 24 subtractions 30,000.00. Form 2 page 1: line 1 federal AGI 40,000.00; line 2 Form 1040 lines 12e and 13b 15,750.00; line 3 24,250.00; line 4 0.00; line 5 30,000.00; line 6 age 65 subtraction 0 x 5,660.00 = 0.00; line 7 Montana taxable income 24,250.00 + 0.00 - 30,000.00 - 0.00 = -5,750.00, zero or less, so 0.00. Page 2 worksheet: line 1 taxable income 0.00; no net long-term capital gain, so lines 2-10 are skipped and line 11 is 0.00; line 12 ordinary income tax from the PDF p18 rate table: 4.7% x 0.00 = 0.00; line 13 = 0.00, carried to page 1 line 8. Bracket schedule as numbers (the expected figure): 4.7% x 0.00 = 0.00. Line 9 nonrefundable credits 0.00; line 10 tax after credits 0.00.
